task: Move heavy CI gates (full pytest + SonarQube) from pre-commit to a new pre-push hook, add commit-msg EPMCDME-prefix enforcement, and refactor pre-commit to fast checks only.

technical_risk.label: S
technical_risk.risk_factors: Developers must re-run `make install-hooks` to register the new pre-push stage; existing installs will not get the hook automatically
technical_risk.mitigation: README updated with re-install instructions; CODEMIE_GITHOOKS_ENABLED env-var escape hatch is present on all three hooks; env-override testability pattern (PYTEST_CMD, SONAR_CMD, RUFF_CMD, LICENSE_CMD) makes rollback trivial

key_reasoning.reason: 9 functional files changed (4 modified + 5 new) plus 3 SDLC task artifacts, spanning 4 directories (scripts/git-hooks/, tests/scripts/, repo root, docs/superpowers/); the new-file count of 5 (two hook scripts + three test modules) drives this above M territory

Three distinct hook scripts with different responsibilities (fast pre-commit checks, heavy pre-push gates, commit-msg prefix enforcement), configuration in .pre-commit-config.yaml, and build tooling in Makefile — 3 coordinated components within a single infrastructure subsystem
